answer: Fails RAROC before any stress; otherwise holds in 12 of 22 scenarios; fails the severe case (Debt/EBITDA, Covenants) and Revenue −30% (DSCR, Debt/EBITDA) and 8 more; revenue can fall 35% before DSCR < 1.0.
pd_basis: Engine PD: the What-If XGBoost model re-scored at the stressed grade (scenario notches + rating overlay)

basis.engine: engine.analyse on a stressed copy of the proposal; rate, notch and all-collateral shocks through engine shocks
basis.overlay: Financial-stress rating overlay: one notch for each full band-width the stressed obligor's DSCR or Debt/EBITDA deteriorates from where it stands today (bands: DSCR 2.0, 1.5, 1.25, 1.1, 1.0, 0.8; Debt/EBITDA 3, 4, 5, 6, 8; linear inside a band; the larger of the two moves; never an upgrade; at most 8 notches; EBITDA at or below zero takes the maximum). The PD model has no financial-ratio features, so this overlay carries a financial shock into PD, rating and stage; the book's median DSCR falls and leverage rises from AA to C (corp_borrower_quarter 2026Q2).
basis.stage: IFRS 9 SICR: Stage 2 when the stressed rating is at least the policy's SICR notches (pd_migration) below the rating at origination (today, for a new deal), or the stressed DSCR is below 1.0 (debt service not covered, a watch-list trigger); Stage 3 at CC or worse (unlikely to pay).
basis.bands: Pass, amber, breach: amber when a ratio is within 10% of its covenant or limit, or RAROC is within 2 points of the hurdle; breach when the limit, the covenant, DSCR 1.0, the hurdle or Stage 1 is lost.
